messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — PR #18976 is green locally and has approvals but is blocked by a flaky Windows job in CI and the infra team scheduled a DB migration blackout tomorrow 10:30-11:00 PST. Can we coordinate a merge slot or a fallback? :wave:

sam: @maya thanks — can you paste the failing job log? If it's just a flaky matrix we can try a rerun or move to a later slot.

maya: pasted the failing snippet below (this is the only failing job across runs):
```
--- FAIL: TestWindowsIntegration (0.12s)
    integration_windows_test.go:47: got timeout waiting for kv-store mount
    logs: mount error: timed out waiting for volume attach
```

jen: ops says the DB migration blackout is necessary for the schema rollforward. If we hit the blackout window the migration will lock the schema for ~12m — not great for deploys. Can we land before 10:30 PST or defer till after 11:00?

leo: If it's just volume attach flake, rerunning the Windows job usually fixes it. But we have limited CI concurrency before the blackout. @release-bot can we do a single rerun and hold merge until canary passes?

release-bot: @leo requested a rerun of job `ci-windows-matrix` for PR #18976 — queued. ETA ~3m. :gear:

ops-bot: Note: There is a scheduled DB blackout at 2025-11-07T18:30:00Z (10:30 PST local). Any landing during that window may be delayed.

sam: Rerun finished — Windows job passed this time. :tada: Two approvals still present. Who wants to volunteer for a quick canary at 10:10 PST to be safe? We can set a 15m rollback window.

maya: I can trigger canary at 10:10 PST. Plan: land to canary tag, smoke test single endpoint, then cut to prod at 10:50 if stable. If anything odd, rollback to previous tag.

jen: Sounds good. Please add the rollback commands in the PR description and ping infra when you start canary. :+1:

leo: Added rollback snippet to PR: `kubectl set image deploy/api api=image:v18976-old && kubectl rollout undo deploy/api` — copied to runbook.

maya: Starting canary at 10:10 PST and pinging infra now. Will update thread after smoke. :eyes:

release-bot: Canary deployment started for PR #18976 at 2025-11-07T17:10:00Z (10:10 PST). Watch logs at https://ci.example.com/build/18976/canary

maya: Canary smoke passed (basic /health, /predict) at 10:18 PST. Proceeding to prod cut at 10:50 PST if no regressions.

sam: Thanks everyone — documenting final timing in the release board. If anything changes, flag here. :lock:
